flow: ui-path (ChatDriver) — composer insertText + Enter, streamed answer

steps.note: session snapshot injected (data/chat.deepseek.com/.session). AWS WAF JS challenge on / must be cleared by the real browser; the page then reads localStorage userToken and Bearer-auths itself.
trusted keyboard.insertText into composer candidate (see profile composer). Optional args.thinking flips the in-page thinking toggle (backed by localStorage thinkingEnabledStorageHandle).

rpc: wire (verified from bundles): POST /api/v0/chat/completion {chat_session_id, parent_message_id, model_type, prompt, ref_file_ids, thinking_enabled, search_enabled, source, action, preempt} → SSE stream of JSON-patch deltas (events ready/delta/toast/title/finish/close/hint/updateSession/updateParentMessage/updateFile; envelope {data:{biz_code,biz_data,biz_msg}}); auth via localStorage userToken as Bearer; PoW header X-DS-PoW-Response required (browser solves invisibly). The UI path drives the site's own JS so no PoW mining is needed.
stealth: real session, trusted inputs, site's own send handler — indistinguishable from the user typing; PoW/WAF handled by the real browser
notes: composer/send/answer selectors (.ds-markdown) remain UNVERIFIED candidates — the SPA rendered classes were not observable without a browser. model_type for the session is server-driven (/api/v0/client/settings model_configs); drive the in-page toggle for reasoning mode unless a live model_type read is wired up.
